change: Remove automatic sales-stage, strength and product defaults from new visits; allow blank stage in dependent followups
behavior: New visits have empty sales stage and strength and no selected products.
Sales stage and strength can explicitly be cleared with Not specified.
Saving an ordinary visit does not require a buying need.
Followups preserve an absent source sales stage rather than defaulting to new.
Next action and followup date remain required.
Existing recorded selections are preserved; no historical database cleanup is performed.
Customer changes clear carried sales selections.
